ValidationRule.description: Delivered shipments are locked except for return transitions; tracking number and carrier cannot change after shipping.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Delivered'), ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Returned'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Shipped_At__c))), OR(ISCHANGED(Tracking_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Carrier__c))) ) )
